rows.en:
Geez, you're late!
You need to show up on time, you know.
Sorry, sorry. Class ran long...

We're in the same class!
That excuse won't work on me!
Oops...

I can't get anything done if my model
doesn't show up!
Okay, okay, I'm sorry.
Come on, don't move!
Geez, that's not the pose you had before!
Sorry, sorry. Was it like this?
Yes, now hold it right there!

Affinity ending.
Filler for Nanase (female).
rows.notes: Developer placeholder under Alto's name plate (female branch of frd_nns_009, male branch of frd_nns_010: the branches each scene does not use). Translated literally in the format of c04107/c06032.

rows.en: Sorryyy, class ran long...
Oh, whoops...
Okaaay, I'm sorryyy.
Oh, sorry. Was it like this?

(Oh, there's Nanase. Perfect timing.
I'll ask her.)

Oh, \p-kun?
What is it?

Oh, I'm sorry...
I'll be at Nyan-Nyan anyway, but for my part-time job...
Please ask me again sometime. See you.

Oh, \p-san?
What is it?
(We're still not that close, huh...)

Huh? The Observation Pier...?
Um, well... maybe some other time...
I'm sorry. Please invite me again, okay?

The Macross Quarter...?
I'm just not that interested in it, I guess...

Folmo? That sounds nice~
Oh, but I just remembered, I have plans
this weekend...

"199"? That's not bad at all!
Oh, but I just remembered, I have plans
this weekend...

The artificial island...?
It's not a bad idea, but...

Central Park... That sounds nice~
Oh, but I just remembered, I have plans
this weekend...

The Battle Frontier...?
I'm just not that interested in it, I guess...

(Okay, that's it for classes...
Maybe I'll invite Nanase to stop off
somewhere on the way home...)

Hey, Nanase. You wanna stop off somewhere
on the way home?

Oh, \p-kun.
Hmm, that doesn't sound bad...
...Oh!?

I'm sorry, I have something to do after this...
Um, please ask me again, okay?
Okay. That's too bad, but it can't be helped.

(Okay, that's it for classes...
Maybe I'll invite Nanase to stop off
somewhere on the way home...)

Hey, Nanase. You wanna stop off somewhere
on the way home?

Oh, \p-san.
Hmm, that doesn't sound bad...
...Oh!?
Okay. That's too bad, but it can't be helped.
(Well, I can always ask her again.)

(Now, plans for this weekend...
Maybe I'll invite Nanase to Griffith Park
and just take it easy...)

Oh, \p-kun.
What is it?

Griffith Park? That sounds lovely.
...Oh!?

Um, I've got something else to do this weekend...
I'm sorry! Please ask me again!

Oh, \p-san.
What is it?

(Now, plans for this weekend...
Maybe I'll invite Nanase to go shopping
in Deep Akihabara...)

Deep Akihabara? That sounds kind of fun.
...Oh!?

(Now, plans for this weekend...
Maybe I'll invite Nanase to go see a concert
at the Sky Gate...)

Sure, that might be nice once in a while.
...Oh!?

(Now, plans for this weekend...
Maybe I'll invite Nanase to Nyan-Nyan...)

Sure, it'd be nice to go as a customer
for once...
...Oh!?

(Now, plans for this weekend...
Maybe I'll invite Nanase to go sketching
in Central Park...)

Well, I was wondering if you'd want to go
sketching in Central Park with me this weekend...

Huh?!
You draw, \p-kun?
Well, that's... um...

You don't have to go out of your way
to match my interests, you know.
(Guess that was a little off the mark...)

Yeah, I was wondering if you'd want to go
sketching in Central Park with me this weekend...

Huh?!
You draw, \p-san?
(Guess that was way off the mark...)
(A new life on a new planet...)

(I'll do my best to get closer to everyone
and make school life even more fun!)

(I've gotta do my best to get closer to everyone
and make school life even more fun!)

uncertain: c11862: Nanase says 'onaji kurasu ja nai desu ka' (we're in the same class) although she is in the Art Course; translated as written.
c11870: developer placeholder under Alto's name plate, translated literally as the earlier fillers (c04107).
c11889: male-worded inner line (da na) also tagged for the female branch in frd_nns_109; the English is gender-neutral.
c11881: Nanase's flustered refusal of the Observation Pier read as embarrassment (a date spot), kept as hesitant 'Um, well... maybe some other time...'.
c11898: 'ask her again' (female branch only; Nanase is known female).
